product.name: Aurelio SkinShield 30ml
product.description: Aurelio SkinShield 30ml is a lightweight, silicone‑based hair serum formulated to protect and nourish the scalp while delivering a smooth, frizz‑free finish. The blend of aloe vera extract, jojoba oil, and vitamin E provides antioxidant support and moisture retention for all hair types. The product is applied to damp hair, focusing on the mid‑lengths and ends, and can be used daily without buildup. Its rose‑gold finish adds a subtle sheen, and the compact bottle is designed for easy travel. The serum is free from parabens, sulfates, and artificial fragrances, making it suitable for sensitive skin.
